FAQ

A crypto advertising network connects advertisers promoting blockchain, cryptocurrency, iGaming, and other Web3-driven projects with publishers who manage crypto-related websites. With AADS, you can easily launch targeted crypto ad campaigns across multiple platforms and reach exactly the audience you need.

AADS stands out for its transparency, affordable traffic costs, and advanced campaign optimization tools. It allows you to advertise crypto projects globally while maintaining full control over your budget and targeting.

Yes. AADS supports ads for Bitcoin, altcoins, and other blockchain platforms. Whether you want to promote a crypto exchange, a wallet, or a DeFi product, our network helps you run safe and effective cryptocurrency advertising campaigns. We also provide traffic suitable for promoting non-crypto projects.

You can start immediately. AADS offers a self-serve dashboard where advertisers can set up crypto ads, choose ad formats, and launch campaigns in just a few minutes.

We support multiple ad formats, including banner ads, video banners, text ads, and responsive ad formats.

AADS allows full flexibility — you can start small and scale as you see results. You can set a daily spending budget to ensure you stay within your planned limits and don't exceed your overall budget.

While Google Ads has strict rules for crypto promotion, AADS specializes in cryptocurrency advertising and provides an alternative that's fully compliant with industry standards, giving you greater freedom to advertise a wide range of crypto projects.

Yes. Our support team helps advertisers with campaign setup, targeting strategies, and performance optimization — ensuring your crypto ad campaigns deliver the best ROI. You can reach out to us via live chat, and our managers will help you with the setup.

Absolutely. Publishers can join the AADS network to display high-quality crypto ads and earn revenue from their traffic. We provide simple integration, fast payouts, and transparent performance tracking.
